scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @spletch/server" "npm run dev -w @spletch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spletch/server && npm run build -w @spletch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @spletch/server && npm run typecheck -w @spletch/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @spletch/server && npm run test -w @spletch/web
scripts.check: npm run security:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
